Incomplete; while financial contributions may be part of offsets, physical restoration (reforestation, habitat dedication) is typically required. Incorrect scope; both government and private projects must provide environmental offsets if habitat is impacted. Environmental offsets for habitat impacts include reforestation, habitat restoration on the site or elsewhere, and dedication of conservation land—these are physical mitigation measures, not just financial. Environmental offsets can require setting aside project land for conservation or restoring habitat elsewhere—impacts site planning and buildable area.
